page.title: Import tickets
page.subtitle: Bring tickets from another help desk into Breeze, one source at a time.
page.denied: Ticket import is available to partner administrators with access to all organizations.
page.sourceMissing: This source no longer exists. It may have been deleted.

sources.title: Sources
sources.loadFailed: Could not load the import sources.

connect.intro: Enter the help desk's address and an API token for a dedicated, read-only user. The token is stored encrypted and is never shown again.
connect.label: Label
connect.baseUrlHelp: The address you open the help desk at, over HTTPS.
connect.tokenHelp: Create it for a dedicated agent with read access to every group, and set it to expire after the cutover.
connect.principalCreate: Create a new import principal named "{{name}}". You become its owner.
connect.principalCreated: Use the import principal created on the previous attempt.
connect.principalReuse: Reuse an import principal you own
connect.principalReuseNone: You own no principal that can be reused (it must be active, hold tickets:write, have no active key and no source).
connect.principalHelp: Imported tickets are written by this principal. Only its owner can edit the source, its mappings, and open its migration windows.
connect.principalsFailed: Could not load your service principals. You can still create a new one.
connect.principalFailed: Could not create the import principal.

source.title: Source: {{label}}
source.revokedHelp: The token was revoked. The mappings and run history are kept: enter a new token to reconnect and resume.
source.notOwner: Only the import principal's owner can edit this source.
source.newTokenHelp: Leave empty to keep the current token. A new address on another host needs a new token.
source.revokeMessage: Breeze deletes the stored token. The source, its mappings and its run history stay, so a later import can reconnect with a new token and resume.
source.deleteMessage: This deletes the source with its mappings, runs and ledger. Imported tickets and the import principal stay. A new source would import every ticket again.

preflight.title: Preflight
preflight.intro: Checks object storage, the token and what it can see, before anything is mapped or imported.
preflight.revoked: The token is revoked. Reconnect the source in the Connect step first.
preflight.storageBlocksImport: An import cannot start without object storage, because attachments are stored there. A dry run still works.
preflight.clockUnknown: Clock difference: unknown (the help desk sent no date)

warnings.no_visible_tickets: The token can see no tickets.
warnings.version_unreadable: The help desk version could not be read.
warnings.identity_unreadable: The token user could not be read.
warnings.permissions_unreadable: The token's permissions could not be read.
warnings.token_user_not_agent: The token user is not an agent (ticket.agent).
warnings.group_access_unknown: The token user's group access could not be read.
warnings.groups_unreadable: The groups could not be read.
warnings.group_inactive: Group {{detail}} is inactive: its tickets will not be imported unless you reactivate it for the import.
warnings.group_unreadable: The token user cannot read group {{detail}}: its tickets will not be imported.
warnings.token_not_read_only: The token can change data in the help desk. Revoke it after the cutover.

preflight.attributesHelp: Custom attributes are not imported; the report counts the tickets that have them.

mappings.title: Mappings
mappings.intro: Choose where each source organization's tickets go, and how groups, priorities and states translate.
mappings.needsPreflight: Run the preflight to load the source's organizations, groups, priorities and states.
mappings.notOwner: Only the import principal's owner can change the mappings.
mappings.locked: The mappings are locked while a run is in progress.
mappings.orgsHelp: {{mapped}} of {{total}} mapped. Tickets of a skipped organization are not imported unless a fallback is set.
mappings.fallbackHelp: Receives the tickets of skipped organizations and of tickets with no organization.
mappings.groupsHelp: A group mapped to no category imports its tickets without one.
mappings.statesHelp: By default each state follows its type (open, pending, closed…). Override a custom state here.
mappings.createContactsHelp: Off by default. On, a requester with an email and no matching contact in the target organization becomes a contact, without portal access. Turn it on before the bulk run: requesters are not re-applied later.
mappings.updatedSinceHelp: Optional. Older tickets keep a display-only requester.
mappings.timeAccountingNote: Add the accounted time as one internal note

intro.dryRun: A dry run reads every ticket and converts it, but writes nothing. Its report predicts what an import would do, including how many contacts it would create. Fix and repeat until the report is what you expect.
intro.bulk: The bulk run imports every mapped ticket through the open migration window. The help desk stays live meanwhile. Run it again to retry failed tickets: it only loads what failed or changed.
intro.delta: After freezing the help desk, the delta run imports what changed since the bulk run: new comments and files, header changes, and the status unless someone changed it in Breeze.

run.cancelMessage: The run stops at the next ticket. What it already imported stays, and a later run resumes from there.
run.revoked: The token is revoked: reconnect the source before starting a run.
run.needsWindow: An import needs an open migration window.
run.otherActive: Another run of this source is in progress.
run.frozen: The help desk is frozen: its email channels are stopped and agents no longer work there. Its API stays reachable for the import.
run.readFailed: Could not refresh the run; retrying.

stopReason.source_unavailable: Stopped: the help desk stopped answering.
stopReason.worker_lost: Stopped: the worker was lost. Start the run again to resume.
stopReason.enqueue_failed: The run could not be queued.

report.contactsToCreateNone: None. Turn on "Create missing requester contacts" to create them.
report.contactsOverCap: Past 5,000 distinct addresses the count is no longer deduplicated: {{count}} addresses were counted without it, so these numbers are a ceiling.
report.customAttributes: Custom attributes with a value (not imported)
report.issuesDropped: {{count}} more issues were counted but not listed.

kind.comments_changed: Comment edited or made internal in the source
kind.org_changed: Moved to another organization in the source

code.clock_skew: Date too far in the future
code.source_missing: Not found in the help desk
code.source_shape_invalid: Unexpected answer from the help desk

window.title: Migration window
window.intro: A migration window lets the import principal write the mapped organizations' tickets for a limited time, at most 14 days. One window covers the bulk and the delta run. Opening it needs your second factor.
window.notOwner: Only the import principal's owner can open its window.
window.otherOpen: Another migration window is open ({{label}}). A partner has one open window at a time: close it first.
window.noOrgs: Map at least one organization (or a fallback) first.
window.endsAtHelp: At most {{days}} days from now. End it a couple of days after the cutover.
window.writesPerHourHelp: Between 600 and the server's ceiling (20,000 by default).
window.openFailed: Could not open the migration window.
window.isOpen: The window is open until {{ends}}, at {{rate}} writes per hour.

stepUp.heading: Confirm with your second factor
stepUp.intro: Opening a migration window lets the import write tickets in these organizations.
stepUp.passkey: Your passkey will be requested when you confirm.
stepUp.noFactor: This needs an authenticator app or a passkey.
stepUp.retry: The confirmation expired. Enter a new code.
stepUp.unavailable: Could not start the confirmation. Try again.

close.title: Close the window
close.intro: Once mail points at Breeze, close the window. Each organization then receives its import summary.
close.noWindow: This source has no migration window.
close.runActive: A run is still in progress: it stops when the window closes.
close.afterRevokeSource: Revoke the source's token here, or keep the source for a later re-import.
close.afterSourceRevoked: The source's token is already revoked.
close.afterRevokeToken: Revoke the token in the help desk too.
close.afterGroups: Deactivate the groups you reactivated for the import.

windows.title: Migration windows
windows.loadFailed: Could not load the migration windows.
windows.closeMessage: The import principal stops writing at once and a running import stops. A window cannot be reopened: a later import opens a new one.
windows.closeFailed: Could not close the migration window.

contacts.title: Contacts created by this source
contacts.intro: Requester contacts the import created. Removing them as a set keeps any that gained a portal login, a role or another link, or were edited.
contacts.loadFailed: Could not load the created contacts.
contacts.name: Name
contacts.removeMessage: Deletes up to 500 contacts per click ({{count}}{{more}} listed as imported). Their tickets keep the requester's name and email.
contacts.result: Removed {{removed}}, kept {{skipped}}, {{remaining}} left for the next click.
contacts.stoppedByRun: Stopped: a run of this source started.
contacts.runActive: Contacts cannot be removed while a run is in progress.
